grf.observed_reality: Current FRANK_V0_1 workspace treats run 31423170075 as target-VPS evidence. Its historical workflow routes only with generic [self-hosted, Linux, X64], and its downloaded environment receipt reports runner_name=clay with kernel hostname digital-retina. Current ProductStart read-only observations route through the same generic label family but report host clayverse across runner names clay, clay-2 and clay-3.
grf.generated_reality: Workflow title/runner naming may have been used as a proxy for exact accepted Hostinger target identity even though generic self-hosted routing does not itself bind one physical/virtual machine.
grf.counter_reality: An independent owner/deployment-side target identity proof may exist outside the searched workflow/repository surfaces; historical runner registrations may also have been intentionally migrated or renamed. Neither possibility rescues runner-name/workflow-title identity as sufficient evidence by itself.
grf.discriminating_test: Compare historical and current run-owned host metadata for generic self-hosted lanes, then inspect current acceptance workflows/repository material for an independently pinned exact target-host identity witness.
grf.collapse: Generic self-hosted execution, runner name and VPS-like workflow naming are insufficient to promote a receipt to exact accepted-Hostinger evidence. The exact host provenance of run 31423170075 is therefore unverified by the observed receipt chain even though its mechanism measurements may remain valid for the machine actually observed.
